name: meta-ads
title_zh: 从权限链到像素验证，Meta 广告全流程不靠猜
tagline_zh: 别人卡在 Business Manager 权限迷宫，或投完才发现像素没通。这个 Skill 把 API 建广告。
tagline_en: Stuck in Business Manager permission hell or silent pixel failures? This skill chains API campaign creation.
desc_en: Launch and verify Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad campaigns end to end — the Business Manager permission chain, programmatic campaign creation via the Marketing API, the steps that only exist in the browser UI, crop-safe creative, and pixel/Conversions API tracking that is actually proven to work. Use when setting up Meta API access, creating or debugging campaigns, or verifying Meta conversion track
why_zh: 不把 UI 点击当黑箱，也不把 API 当银弹。它明确区分哪些步骤只能浏览器做，哪些能编程。
why_en: Treats neither UI clicks nor API calls as magic. It separates browser-only steps from programmable ones, then validates tracking.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Meta 官方 Marketing API 与 Business Manager 生态。
limit_en: Meta Marketing API & Business Manager only—no TikTok/Google. Requires your own Meta dev account & ad account. Pixel verification needs CAPI access.
title_en: Meta ads end-to-end: permissions, API, UI, pixel proof
